params.name: fromTimestamp
params.description: Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) to retrieve records from this point in time

params.name: toTimestamp
params.description: Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) to retrieve records up to this point in time

params.name: clientAccountId
params.description: Unique identifier of the exchange account for which records are retrieved

params.name: portfolioIds
params.description: List of Copper portfolio IDs to filter records

params.name: actionType
params.description: Type of action: `add-funds` (delegate to the exchange) or `remove-funds` (undelegate from the exchange)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return (pagination limit)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records to skip before starting to return results (pagination offset)

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: Sort order for results: `asc` for ascending or `desc` for descending

params.name: filterExecuted
params.description: If true, only return records for actions that have been successfully executed (i.e., funds have been successfully added or removed).If false, include all records regardless of execution status

params.name: portfolioId
params.description: Unique Copper account identifier for which records can be retrieved

params.name: nonEmpty
params.description: If `true`, only balances with non-zero values will be returned

params.name: fetchSubaccounts
params.description: If `true`, includes `totalAvailableBalanceToUndelegate` across both the main account and subaccounts

params.name: portfolioId
params.description: Unique Copper account identifier for which records can be retrieved

params.name: clientAccountId
params.description: Exchange account unique identifier for which records can be retrieved

params.name: exchangeSettlementId
params.description: Unique exchange settlement identifier per instruction, defined by client account and settlement currency. Guaranteed to be unique within each exchange.

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds to filter settlements created after this time

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds to filter settlements created before this time

params.name: cycleStartTimestamp
params.description: Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) of the date and time when the settlement cycle has started

params.name: cycles
params.description: The number of most recent cycles that you want to retrieve for every exchange. For example, specifying 1 will return the last settlement for every queried exchange

params.name: clearLoopSettlementStatuses
params.description: Comma separated list with statuses to be included. [See details](/enums/ClearLoopSettlementStatus)

params.name: clearLoopSettlementStatusesNotIn
params.description: Comma separated list with statuses not to be included. [See details](/enums/ClearLoopSettlementStatus)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return (pagination limit)

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: The sorting order of settlement records, which are sorted by their `createdAt` field: `asc` (ascending) or `desc` (descending)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records to skip before starting to return results (pagination offset)
